title: Create a MyAPES account from a client profile
summary: Staff can create a MyAPES account from a client form or Account Management with a temporary password that expires in 72 hours; the person must choose a permanent password on first sign-in.
changes: Add a Create MyAPES account tick box on the new-client form; unticked still saves a profile-only client.
Account Management on a profile-only client with an email can create the account later; Invited accounts can resend sign-in details.
Usernames use firstname.lastname (with a number when taken); temporary passwords are hashed, single-use and expire after 72 hours.
Welcome email includes username and temporary password once; Admin email preview uses a placeholder and the mail log stores the template name only.
First sign-in redirects to a forced permanent password screen with a live strength meter and personal-identifier checks.
Expired or used temporary passwords show a helpful message without revealing whether the account exists.
Audit events cover account creation from a profile and temporary-password issued, used, expired and resent, without secrets.
Staff guide and privacy notice describe staff-created accounts and emailed sign-in details.
affected_areas: Public Login and forced password change
version_rationale: MINOR: new account-creation flow with temporary password and forced first-sign-in change, replacing the set-password link option for new creates.
validation: PHPUnit StaffClientAccountTest, ClientDetailsAndAccountStateTest, CreateMyApesAccountFromProfileTest, UserProfileHubTest and MailTemplateMatrixTest.
Herd preview at https://myapes-account.test for the Clients form and Account Management create panel.
composer milestone:bump -- v0.79.0 --check and myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: Matching self-registered accounts remains out of scope (v0.81.0).
SMS delivery of temporary passwords is not supported.
Outstanding set-password tokens from earlier releases still work until they expire.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag (v0.78.0). The additive users.must_change_password and users.temporary_password_expires_at columns can remain.
provenance: Milestone v0.79.0 Create a MyAPES account from a client profile, Epic #867, pull request #1072.
